_readme: Source of truth for the Insights section. tools/build-insights.py stamps each article's <head>, header, contents list and closing call to action, plus the hub's filters and cards, from this file. Labels mirror the service pages; an article can carry several. The first label is the article's primary topic. 'generic' labels (AI Usage Best Practices) only count after topic labels when picking related articles. Order in 'articles' is the order on the hub.
